summary: MaintStaffProfile structures and governs the display, editing, and workflow of staff profile information in the HSPnet system. It organizes all staff data into tabbed sections (general, documents, orientation, prerequisites, education, placements, history, recognition, IT provisioning) with role-based access, business rules, validations, and dynamic features for context-sensitive editing, visibility, and business process enforcement.
purpose: To maintain, view, and edit comprehensive staff profiles including personal details, contact information, roles, education, placements, prerequisites, history, orientation, recognition, and IT provisioning. The file ensures correct access, validation, workflow steps, audit, and usability for staff, administrators, and coordinators.

workflows.name: Tab-Based Staff Profile Management
steps: Profile tab: Display/edit basic staff details (with permission checks)
Documents tab: Manage/upload documents; visibility and edit controls
Orientation/EOrientation tabs: Manage orientation records; enable if allowed
Prerequisites tab: Manage confidentiality, certifications, safety/security, infection control, occupational health, site requirements; controls based on data and role
Education tab: Pre- and post-employment education records; visibility depends on role and data
Placements tab: Internal and practice education placements; visibility and edit depends on context
History tab: Placement history, profile history, access history; visibility set by admin and role
Recognition tab: Track staff recognition activities; visibility depends on department policy, role, and data
IT Provision tab: Manage IT provisioning for staff; only enabled if configuration allows and current staff is instructor
Print/refresh/close actions: UI controls for profile printing, refreshing view, closing window

business_rules: Tabs, fields, and edit controls are displayed only to users with sufficient privileges (SystemAdmin, StaffAdmin, LocalAdmin, Placement/Receiving/Destination Coordinators, etc.)
Sections (Profile, Training, Home Contacts, Portfolio, Email Messages) report existence with flags; visibility is set by data and role.
Recognition tab enabled only if department tracks recognition or recognition entries exist.
Editing allowed only if user is admin, or allowed by department access, or viewing own profile.
In 'PRHistoryOnly', only placement history shown for supervisors; other tabs hidden.
In RecognitionOnly or ITProvisionOnly modes, only relevant tabs enabled.
Confidentiality, certifications, safety, infection control, occupational health, site requirements tabs enabled if data exists and user is allowed.
Post-employment education hidden for staff applicants; switched to pre-employment if last tab was post-employment.
Contact info hidden if department policy requires and staff is not in user's agency.
Profile history, access history visible only to sysadmin, staff admin, local admin (with access) or the staff member.
validations: Phone field: Mask and custom validator to enforce area code and phone format; enabled by system setting.
Email/SecureEmail fields: Required and regular expression validators; secure email must be different from regular email.
Sub-discipline selections: Prevent duplicates across fields; custom validators applied.
Skills/interests: Prevent duplicates; custom validation with field comparisons.
Date fields: Custom and regular expression validators for short date, max/min, expiry checks (e.g. for certifications, placements, activities).
Document upload: If type is 'Document/Tool', document name and upload must be present.
Visibility of edit controls determined by department access and session status.
calculations: Expiry date calculation for certifications: e.g., Tetanus, N95 Mask Fit Test, certificate dates auto-calculated based on admin date and duration.
Leap year logic for Feb 29; adjusts expiry date to Mar 1 if leap day required.
Auto-formatting for display of last login, date of birth, and other date/time fields.
conditions: Role and department access (EditAllowed, CostTrackerViewAllowed, AccessHistoryViewAllowed, ReadOnly) set via department and session variables.
Show/hide tabs, fields, and edit controls based on user role, department, configuration, and specific staff profile data.
Special modes (PRHistoryOnly, RecognitionOnly, ITProvisionOnly) alter which tabs and workflow steps are visible.
If staff applicant, hide post-employment education; switch to pre-employment if needed.
DefaultTab query string determines initial tab selection.
system_behavior: Page load sets up session, role-based access, tab visibility, and relevant client-side scripts.
Tab navigation triggers loading and binding of relevant controls and child user controls.
Ajax controls keep warning/error panels visible on scroll.
Print action calls HTML report generation and displays in panel.
Error and warning panels process messages dynamically.
Child controls (documents, prerequisites, education, placements, history, recognition) are linked, un-linked, made visible or hidden depending on tab and permissions.
Grid controls and form views use dynamic data binding and UI feedback (selected, editable, read-only, disabled, hidden).
dependencies: StaffController for fetching staff profile data
Configuration codes for IT Provisioning and other features
Child user controls for each tab/subsection of the profile
exceptions: If department hides contact info and staff not in user's agency, contact details hidden.
If no edit allowed by role or department, all fields are read-only.
Certain tabs disabled if special mode (PRHistoryOnly, RecognitionOnly, ITProvisionOnly) is enabled.
If missing required fields or duplicate entries in forms, custom validators prevent updates.
If StaffID not found, profile sections return empty or hidden.
